name: evalforge
description: Control plane for repeatable LLM evaluations and regression checks.

scripts.setup: python -m pip install -e "backend[dev]" -e worker -e cli && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.format: python -m ruff format backend worker cli tests && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: python -m ruff format --check backend worker cli tests && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.lint: python -m ruff check backend worker cli tests && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: python -m mypy backend/src worker/src cli/src && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: python -m pytest tests && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run
scripts.validate:backend: python -m ruff check backend worker cli tests && python -m ruff format --check backend worker cli tests && python -m mypy backend/src worker/src cli/src && python -m pytest tests
scripts.validate:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run
scripts.validate: npm run validate:backend && npm run validate:frontend
